meta.name: imagegen-frontend-web
meta.description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网站每个区块生成高质量设计参考图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站每个区块生成风格统一的设计参考图
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality design reference images for each website section
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need design reference images for each section of a website

howto.what: 你描述一个网页或落地页,它会为每一个版块单独生成一张横向设计参考图:说 8 个版块就出 8 张,不会把多个版块压进一张图。落地页默认按 6 个版块、整站模板默认按 8 个算。
howto.when: 当你要求做落地页、营销站点或产品页的设计参考图时;说「整站模板」会按 8 个版块处理,未指定数量则按 6 个版块处理。

say.text: 帮我做一个 SaaS 落地页的设计参考图,共 6 个版块
say.note: 输出 6 张独立横向图,每版块一张

say.text: 这是整站模板,按 8 个版块生成参考图
say.note: 依次生成 8 张,标注 Section N of 8

say.text: 落地页改成 4 个版块,英雄区用极简小尺寸
say.note: 英雄区缩放与构图按你的要求调整

howto.what_en: You describe a page and it generates one separate horizontal design-reference image per section — 8 sections, 8 images, never combined into one tall page. 'Landing page' defaults to 6 sections; 'full website template' to 8.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a landing page, marketing site or product page design reference; a 'full website template' is treated as 8 sections, and an unspecified count defaults to 6.

say_en.text: Make a design reference for a SaaS landing page with 6 sections
say_en.note: Outputs 6 separate horizontal images, one per section

say_en.text: This is a full website template — generate images for 8 sections
say_en.note: 8 images in sequence, labeled Section N of 8

say_en.text: Rework the landing page to 4 sections with a mini minimalist hero
say_en.note: Hero scale and composition follow your brief
